verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs describe Fluid compute scaling concurrency on demand for I/O and AI-heavy workloads, and its serverless/edge model implies automatic scaling without manual capacity planning. Community evidence (comm-12) corroborates that traffic surges are absorbed automatically (e.g., during undetected DDoS) but flags that this comes with unpredictable billing spikes rather than guaranteed cost controls. missing for 10: explicit SLA or benchmark data on burst-scale limits, first-party documentation of autoscaling triggers/thresholds, and independent load-test evidence beyond the anecdotal billing complaint.
